pipeline.license_origin: Licensed to GSK Sept 2022 (development/manufacture/commercialization, IND and NDA ownership transferred to GSK)

indications.indication: Complicated urinary tract infection (cUTI) including pyelonephritis
indications.trial_design: Randomized, double-blind, double-dummy, active-controlled global non-inferiority trial vs IV imipenem-cilastatin
indications.trial_status: COMPLETED — IDMC stopped trial early for efficacy; primary endpoint of non-inferiority met; FDA NDA filing planned 2H 2025 (per company)

excluded_legacy_terminated.reason: March 2025 — company announced reprioritization, ceased development of SPR206 (HABP/VABP polymyxin)
November 2025 — company ceased development of SPR720 for first-line MAC pulmonary disease following Phase 2 (NCT05496374 completed; earlier Phase 2 NCT04553406 terminated)
Legacy potentiator program; only Phase 1 completed, no current development
